title: PiPi — Chatbot at Bamnang
subtitle: A multilingual chatbot helping students discover universities, scholarships, and mentors in one conversation.
description: Bringing Bamnang's educational resources together so students can ask questions naturally in English, Khmer, or Khmer Latin.
appPrompt: Experience PiPi firsthand by downloading and testing the Bamnang App.

images.title: Campus & Major Discovery
images.caption: Exploring universities, faculties, and admission details via conversation

images.title: Mentor Consultation
images.caption: Inquiring about mentors, guidance, and scheduled study sessions

images.title: Scholarship Search
images.caption: Discovering active scholarships, eligibility, and application deadlines

situation.title: The Situation
situation.paragraph: Bamnang offers helpful information about universities, majors, scholarships, events, and mentors, but this knowledge was scattered across different places. At the same time, students communicate in different ways—some type in English, some in Khmer script, and many in Khmer Latin. This made it difficult for students to find clear answers quickly through a single conversation.

task.title: The Task
task.paragraph: The goal was to make PiPi understand and respond accurately across English, Khmer, and Khmer Latin, while uniting all Bamnang knowledge into one seamless chat experience that feels simple, natural, and helpful for any student.

action.title: The Action
action.paragraph: I organized knowledge from multiple Bamnang sources and designed the conversation flow to handle mixed-language inputs smoothly. By testing real student queries and everyday phrasing, I refined the responses to ensure answers were direct, easy to understand, and focused on what students actually need.
points: Conducted technical research to evaluate LLM frameworks, agent architectures, and tools suitable for Bamnang’s chatbot.
Designed the multi-agent chatbot architecture and defined how different agents should handle different student needs.
Organized and structured knowledge from multiple Bamnang sources for chatbot use.
Designed the conversation flow to support different types of student questions and interactions.
Worked on multi-language support for Khmer, English, and mixed Khmer-English inputs.
Designed the database structure to support chatbot knowledge, conversations, sessions, and related data.
Tested the chatbot with real student questions and everyday phrasing to identify gaps and improve responses.
Refined prompts and chatbot logic to make answers direct, simple, and relevant.
Worked on the backend implementation end-to-end, connecting chatbot logic, knowledge sources, database, and APIs.
Iteratively improved the system based on real usage, testing, and student needs.

result.title: The Result
result.paragraph: PiPi now offers a friendly, multilingual way for students to explore educational opportunities in one place, making school and scholarship guidance accessible no matter how they choose to communicate.

title: Major-Recommendation at Bamnang (MCT)
subtitle: A guided test helping students connect their interests and strengths with suitable university majors and careers.
description: Guiding high school graduates from self-understanding to matching job clusters and university majors.
appPrompt: Experience the Major Career Test (MCT) firsthand by downloading and testing the Bamnang App.

images.title: Interactive Self-Discovery
images.caption: Guided questionnaire assessing student interests, skills, and personal strengths

images.title: Career Cluster Matching
images.caption: Connecting student characteristics with relevant professional fields and job pathways

images.title: Actionable Major Suggestions
images.caption: Clear breakdown of recommended university majors and curriculum directions

situation.title: The Situation
situation.paragraph: Many students want a good career after graduation but struggle to pick the right university major because they are unsure of their strengths, interests, and potential job paths. Bamnang needed a simple, guided tool to help students explore their options without feeling overwhelmed.

task.title: The Task
task.paragraph: The goal was to build a student-friendly assessment that turns questionnaire answers into meaningful recommendations with clear explanations, rather than just displaying raw numbers or arbitrary test scores.

action.title: The Action
action.paragraph: I designed the Major Career Test around students' real interests and traits, mapping their answers directly to relevant job clusters. I structured the results so students can step-by-step connect who they are to possible career paths and matching majors.
points: Conducted a literature review with the college to research global career clusters, workforce trends, and relevant career/education data.
Translated the research into a career-cluster framework that connects students’ interests and traits with potential career directions.
Designed the Major Career Test logic and scoring flow, including how student responses determine relevant job clusters and career paths.
Designed and developed the backend architecture end-to-end, from database structure and APIs to scoring, mapping, and result generation.
Structured the result experience so students can move step-by-step from self-understanding → job clusters → career paths → relevant university majors.
Integrated the test with the broader platform so the results can support personalized recommendations and future student guidance.

result.title: The Result
result.paragraph: Students now receive clear, personalized recommendations that explain why certain majors fit them, helping them make confident, informed decisions about their university education.
